context.text: Hey! Ten minutes to your 6:30. After each question, stop and leave a real pause, like you're waiting for their answer.

transcript.text: [voice: Tell me about the last time you had to follow up with a client. ... What did you do next? ... What did you use to keep track of that follow-up?]
Nice one, Yanni! All three questions came through, and the tracking question sounds natural after the other two 🎙️ How did it feel saying them out loud? Did any of them feel clunky?
Okay is a good start. What's behind it? Was it easy, or did saying them out loud to an imaginary freelancer feel a bit awkward?
